notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup (Shopify plugin). Owner: co-founder & Head of Ops (Claire Alvarez). Small, Shopify-hosted home-goods retailer focused on curated vintage-style ceramics and small furniture. Catalog ~6k SKUs (variants ~18k). Signup details: used free credits to run embedding-based search on product titles and tried text-generation for short product Q&As. Quote from call: 'We need something that doesn't surprise us on cost — predictable billing is key.'

Primary needs: fast product Q&A widget for product pages (latency <500ms for snippet answers), catalog enrichment (auto-extract attributes: material, dimensions, era), embeddings for on-site search + related-items. Workload profile: heavy bursts tied to email drops and weekend promos (traffic spikes 5x baseline for ~2 hours). Cost sensitivity: high — prefer pay-as-you-go and guidance on batching/caching.

Technical constraints: Shopify + Netlify front-end, Postgres product DB, CDN in us-east; no on-prem or VPC required. Wants easy JS SDK + example for client-side streaming (but OK with server-side proxy). Prototype tests so far: embedding latency acceptable, generator had occasional hallucinations on product provenance — needs prompt guardrails.

Security/compliance: SOC2 not required today but want SSO/SAML and audit logs for any paid plan. Data residency not required.

POC plan (agreed): 1) provide hosted_api trial key & prompt pack; 2) run 1-week A/B test on product Q&A widget; 3) evaluate hallucination rate on 500 queries; 4) decide on renewal/commit.

Sales context: SMB lead, receptive to self-serve but will convert to paid if clear unit economics and low setup time. AE notes: prioritize sample prompts, cost calculator, and a short engineering how-to for Shopify integration.

Stitch items: Drive pricing deck shared (drive:/decks/porcelain-sparrow/pricing-deck-v2.pdf). Fireflies ID for discovery call. Jira INF-1123 opened for initial embedding quality issue (stop-words in attributes).
